metadata.description: KQS SupportFlow for Claude: remote support for your kiosks, workstations and servers through the SupportFlow Client.

plugins.name: kqs-supportflow
plugins.description: Connects Claude to the KQS SupportFlow Client running on this PC: list your stations, read their telemetry, and run ControlKey-signed commands on them. Needs the SupportFlow Client (1.5.19 or later) installed and signed in.
